title: dsx-ai-factory/nvke: a preview control plane for GPU Kubernetes
friendlyTitle: A preview tool for running Kubernetes on your own NVIDIA GPUs
summary: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine was high on GitHub Trending today, with 125 stars in the daily count. It is a management plane for creating separate Kubernetes clusters on your own NVIDIA GPU machines. NVIDIA marks it as a preview and says not to use it for production. A local quickstart can run without GPU hardware, on a Linux host with Docker, 6 CPUs, 12 GiB of memory, and 100 GiB of disk.
friendlySummary: NVKE was trending on GitHub today. It is a control panel for creating Kubernetes clusters on NVIDIA GPU machines that you own. NVIDIA says it is a preview and not ready for production. You can try a local version without a GPU, if the computer has enough CPU, memory, and disk.
whyItMatters: A platform team can try the control loop on simulated machines before committing hardware. A real install still needs your own nodes, images, and NVIDIA Infra Controller, which the preview lists as the only compatible provider.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use the local quickstart to see how the control plane works before you buy machines. A real cluster still needs your own hardware and NVIDIA's infrastructure controller.
